scripts.lint: bun lint --no-script scripts src/**/*.ts tests e2e/*.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.format: bun fmt scripts src/**/*.ts tests e2e/*.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.check: bun --bun astro sync && bun check --no-script && bun --bun astro check
scripts.ci: bun lint && bun fmt --check && bun check && bun test tests && bun run build && bun run check:dist
